products.name: Low
products.description:
A low coffee table in solid reclaimed oak, made for unhurried rooms. A broad, softly rounded rectangular top rests on two oak panel supports joined by a low stretcher. The clear construction gives century-old timber room to show its grain, knots and traces of a former life.

120 × 65 × 38 cm. Available in Natural or Smoked matte oil. Each piece carries its own grain and patina; the gallery shows Natural oak.
products.headline: Quiet form. Deep character.

specifications.label: Construction
specifications.value: 40 mm board-built top; two transverse oak panel supports and a connecting stretcher

faqs.question: How long does production take?
faqs.answer: Each table is made to order. Please allow approximately 30–60 days for production. Delivery is arranged separately; the production window does not include transport time.

faqs.question: Will my table look exactly like the images?
faqs.answer: The gallery shows the design in Natural oak. Reclaimed boards vary in grain, knots and historic markings, so each finished table has its own character. Smoked oil gives the same design a deeper brown tone.

products.description:

products.name: Trestle
products.description:
A generous dining table in solid reclaimed oak, shaped by more than a century of history. A quiet rectangular top rests on two substantial trestles, joined by a low oak stretcher. Honest proportions and softly eased edges let the timber's grain, knots and old markings speak.

220 × 95 × 75 cm. Available in Natural or Smoked matte oil. Each piece carries its own grain and patina; the gallery shows Natural oak.
